name: madori-video
description: Teaser y video explicativo de Madori con HyperFrames. Independiente del monorepo pnpm.

scripts.prep: npm run generar && npm run assets
scripts.check: npm run prep && hyperframes check teaser && hyperframes check explicativo
scripts.preview: npm run prep && hyperframes preview teaser
scripts.preview:explicativo: npm run prep && hyperframes preview explicativo
scripts.teaser: npm run prep && hyperframes render teaser -o out/teaser.mp4
scripts.explicativo: npm run prep && hyperframes render explicativo -o out/explicativo.mp4
